title: Pontoon topology
description: QEMU microVM range definition for Pontoon

defaults.description: Default kernel/initrd paths applied to all services unless overridden

kernel.description: Path to the Linux kernel image (vmlinuz), relative to pontoon.yml

initrd.description: Path to the initramfs image (initrd.gz), relative to pontoon.yml. Used as fallback for VMs without layers (optional).

alpine.description: Alpine Linux tag used as the base for layer builds, e.g. '3.21'

networks.description: Network zones. Each becomes a Linux bridge (br-<name>) on the host.

services.description: VMs to launch. Each service maps to one QEMU microVM process.

network.description: A network zone (Linux bridge on the host)

subnet.description: CIDR subnet for this zone, e.g. '10.99.1.0/24'

internal.description: If true, no host IP is assigned to the bridge (zone is not directly reachable from host)

kernel.description: Override the default kernel path for this VM

initrd.description: Override the default initrd path for this VM

networks.description: Network interfaces for this VM. Order determines eth0, eth1, … assignment.

layers.description: Ordered list of layer names to compose into this VM's initrd. Layers are defined in range/layers/<name>/layer.yml. Packages are merged and sorted for deterministic Docker cache hits. Config files from later layers override earlier ones.

kernel_args.description: Additional kernel cmdline arguments passed to the VM. Values must be space-free.

svc.start.description: Comma-separated list of services to start: 'ssh', 'wallhack', or custom binaries in /usr/local/bin

svc.wallhack.listen.description: wallhack listen address for entry role, e.g. ':4433'

svc.wallhack.connect.description: wallhack connect address for exit role, e.g. '10.99.1.100:4433'

interface.description: Network interface attachment for a VM

ipv4_address.description: Static IP address for this interface (CIDR prefix comes from the network's subnet)

gateway.description: Default gateway IP for this VM (used when this is the VM's only or primary interface)

masquerade.description: If true, apply iptables MASQUERADE on this outgoing interface (enables NAT for forwarded traffic)
